messages.subject: Using new Shiny JS feature
parts:
Working with shiny 12.x I used to send data forth and back between JS and Shiny like explained here: https://ryouready.wordpress.com/2013/11/20/sending-data-from-client-to-server-and-back-using-shiny/
With the new release (13.0) it seems that there are some build in functions in shiny. However, to me it is not clear how I would access a, lets say, reactive dataframe in JS with these new features. It feels like all the functionalities explained here http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/js-events.html are aiming to observe if the user clicks something or if the app is processing something. What I need is to access a dataframe that gets created in Shiny. Is that possible with the new features?!
